pull.title: refactor: prune unused semi-colons
pull.body:
Enable [`-Wextra-semi`](https://clang.llvm.org/docs/DiagnosticsReference.html#wextra-semi) and delete all the redundant semicolons.

Waiting on a pull of the libmultiprocess subtree.
